annotations.title: Prepare creating a Meta ad set

description: Prepare a PAUSED ad set in a Meta campaign. daily_budget in whole account-currency units (20 = 20.00); the preview shows what Meta gets. Changes nothing: returns a preview_id (15 min, one use) for execute_prepared_change.

campaign_id.description: ADS Beast id from list_campaigns, not the platform's.

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in the ad account's currency, whole units.

optimization_goal.description: What Meta optimises the ad set for.

reason.description: Why, with numbers (shown to the approver).

targeting.description: Meta targeting spec: geo_locations, age_min, age_max, genders, locales, interests or flexible_spec, custom audiences, plus audience_rationale.

name: prepare_meta_ad_set_create
